title: Jack Rabbit Rachael Rabbit Redcurrant, Grape and Cherry E-Liquid Shortfill 50ml
description: Redcurrant, Grape & Cherry e-liquid by Rachael Rabbit is a deliciously sweet and sharp fruit blend. The juicy grape and sharp redcurrant on the inhale melts into exquisitely sweet red cherries on the exhale for a deliciously satisfying all-day vape finished to perfection with a streak of cooling ice. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70% VG 30% PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vape mod kits and sub-ohm tanks .
